<Problem>
A service slows down at night and nobody can say why, because nothing recorded how it behaved. This sample step stands in for a real lesson and shows each part a step can have.
</Problem>

Running text sits between the parts and carries the story from one to the next.

<Idea>
Record numbers about the service over time, then ask questions of them. This step exists to test the site, not to teach.
</Idea>

## Parts that hold data

A query can be copied:

<Query lang="promql">{`sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{job="shop"}[5m]))`}</Query>

<Question id="q-m90-s01" answer="b">
Which of these is a number recorded over time?

- A log line

  A log line is text about one event, not a number over time.

- A metric

  Right: a metric is a number sampled over time.

- A trace

  A trace follows one request through services.

- A profile

  A profile shows where a program spends its resources.
</Question>
